text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report presents the results of staff's investigation on a traffic study conducted at the south intersection of Prince Edward Drive North and King Georges Road to determine the feasibility for all-way stop controls. A staff assessment has determined that the criteria for the installation of an all-way stop control are achieved at the south intersection of Prince Edward Drive North and King Georges Road.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way stop control at the south intersection of Prince Edward Drive North and King Georges Road.
